items.title: George Lewis Interview, 1958-11-14
items.q: Kleyber, was playing the drum all this way with Tommy Ladner. ... Tommy Ladner played a while with that Sam Fritz band.

ctx.x: Okay, it's going again. You were talking about Isidore Fritz and different people.

Yeah, I heard because Bunk was supposed to be instructing that band, Isidore Fritz, the old man Fritz, and Loya Fritz, and little Caggley who plays trumpet. B's brother, Kleyber, was playing the drum all this way with Tommy Ladner.
They all came from across the lake today and lived over there.

items.title: George Lewis Interview, 1960-01-25
items.q: there was Tommy Ladner. Leonard Parker was out of Slide Hill, I played with him quite a while.

ctx.x: Never heard, he's the best you ever heard in your whole life, you mean any place, huh?

Any place. Any place. And uh, they had a real, real good band. And there was uh, Leonard Parker around there, there was Tommy Ladner. Leonard Parker was out of Slide Hill, I played with him quite a while. And then Dan Moody, during that time Dan was playing uh, trombone instead of, and he got off the trombone and went, got back on the bass violin.
Who was that foul singer over there, Black Eagle?
